title: Look Before You Leap: Cross-Modal Screenshot-versus-DOM Consistency Checking for Defending GUI Agents against Deceptive Interfaces
why: Cross-modal screenshot-vs-DOM mismatch head plus re-observation policy to defend GUI/web agents against deceptive controls before click.
mechanism: Perception/safety gate: encode screenshot and DOM/a11y channels with a frozen VLM, train g_phi on [p,s,p-s,p*s] mismatch; on flag, pi_theta corrects page (e.g. remove overlay) and re-grounds before acting.
evaluation_signal: Author-reported offline dark-pattern env (14 templates x 3 levels), SusBench transfer probe (does not transfer when channels agree), adaptive aria-morph/overlay attacks; numbers archived under results/ — not independently verified.
evidence_locator: Repository README (overview, reproduction tables Sec. 6.1–6.7, Authors and Citation)
